newsitem.title: USA: ESPN to launch new sports magazine.
newsitem.headline: ESPN to launch new sports magazine.

text.p: All-sports network ESPN Inc. is taking its brand of journalism to the print world.
ESPN, which is owned by Walt Disney Co. and Hearst Corp., plans to introduce its ESPN Magazine, devoted to sports, in the first quarter of 1998, the company said Tuesday.
Michael Rooney, who has been a publisher at Times Mirror Co.'s magazine division, has been named publisher of the new magazine. It is to be published biweekly.
"All our research indicates that both sports fans and advertisers are receptive to an ESPN magazine," ESPN Magazine Senior Vice President John Skipper said in a statement.

John Walsh, ESPN senior vice president and executive editor, who is to help guide the editorial direction of the new publication, said the magazine will have the same feel as ESPN's television programming.
"It's developed a unique voice," Walsh told Reuters. "We try to look at sports through a passionate prism."
ESPN, 80 percent-owned by Disney and 20 percent by Hearst, reaches 212 million homes around the world. Its four-year-old ESPN2 network reaches 46 million homes in the United States.
